messages:
Sofia (PM): quick sync — updated RICE after the customer interviews. two asks jumped: predictive cache (higher impact) and dedicated autoscale (high effort). proposing reweighting and a gating plan, need thumbs or objections
Liam (Eng): +1 to reweight predictive cache. infra risk on burst handling tho. estimate +2 dev-weeks and a short hardening spike test
Noor (Data): ran a sim on cache hit patterns — at 35% hit rate we see ~12% token cost reduction and 18% median latency drop. can paste numbers if useful: link to spreadsheet in the doc cluster
Ethan (Design): small UX changes needed for fallback state if cache miss causes higher variance. low effort (1 sprint half-time). we should add copy for errors
Marco (PM): proposed rollout: internal beta -> canary -> global. canary criteria: 2 weeks, >=5k requests/day, no error rate regression >0.5%
Aisha (Support): flag: three enterprise customers asked for autoscale before Q4 peak. autoscale is a customer blocker for some renewals
Sofia (PM): suggested patch prioritization: Predictive Cache -> P1, Autoscale -> P2, Autoscale quick-win (burst limiter + routing) -> P1. thoughts?
Liam (Eng): we can ship burst limiter fast as a config change + routing policy. agree to move that to P1. Autoscale full implementation stays P2
Noor (Data): confidence for cache numbers is 0.7 (some telemetry skew), reach est: 600k daily requests. putting numbers below for quick RICE calc:
```
feature,reach,impact,confidence,effort,RICE
Predictive Cache,600000,8,0.7,3,1120000
Burst limiter (quick-win),200000,3,0.8,1,480000
Dedicated Autoscale,100000,6,0.6,8,45000
```
Marco (PM): that RICE ordering matches intuition. main debate is sequencing vs parallel work — do we parallelize the quick infra work with the cache engineering?
Ethan (Design): we can stagger design deliverables: cache UX first, autoscale UX later. parallel dev ok as long as infra has clear APIs
Sofia (PM): decision proposal: approve Predictive Cache P1 + Burst limiter P1, Autoscale P2, run a 3-week internal beta for cache, measure cost reduction and error rates, reconvene after beta. please react with :+1: to approve, :thinking_face: for concerns
roadmap-bot: meeting scheduled — Q3 roadmap sync added to calendar for 1768200000 (follow-up in 1 week)
Liam (Eng): :+1:
Noor (Data): :+1: will prepare beta metric dashboard (cost, latency, error rate)
Aisha (Support): :+1: will surface the plan to the three customers and offer early access
Sofia (PM): thanks all — I'll update the ticketing (TRACK-3421) and add canary gating steps. assigning leads: Liam eng, Noor metrics, Ethan UX
Marco (PM): leaving quick note — if the beta shows <8% cost reduction we should pivot to model-level caching instead of prefix cache
Sofia (PM): noted. follow-up thread in a week. thanks everyone.
